findings.message: Base-case cap rate of 5.76% independently verified (NOI $5,580 / $96,900). Well below the 10% threshold; REJECTED classification is supported.
Expense arithmetic verified: $1,800 HOA + $0 assessments + $120 taxes + $300 insurance + $900 management + $0 utilities + $300 other = $3,420 OpEx; gross $9,000 − $3,420 = NOI $5,580.

Zero-HOA scenario yields 7.62%. High-rent ($900/mo) with $0 HOA yields 9.47%—still below 10%. Mid HOA ($150) and high HOA ($200) yield 5.76% and 5.14%. No documented scenario clears the investment threshold.
Independent check: ~$1,092.50/mo rent needed for 10% cap at base HOA ($150/mo); ~$942.50/mo at $0 HOA. Both exceed evidence range_high ($900/mo).
Purchase price VERIFIED HIGH at $96,900 via Trivo Nahla Unit 60 listing.

Rent ESTIMATED MEDIUM at $750/mo (range $650–$900), trimmed below scout $825. Mid-tier estimate is not overly optimistic relative to FazWaz median and Barbasquillo comps; rent is not the reason this fails 10%.

HOA/alicuota UNKNOWN (LOW confidence). Underwriting correctly uses $150/mo mid-point of amenity-building range for math only and does not assert verified zero. Even optimistic $0 HOA leaves base case at 7.62%—material uncertainty plus sub-threshold returns support REJECTED over WATCHLIST.

Special assessments UNKNOWN (LOW confidence). Underwriting includes $0 for math only with explicit caveat that zero cannot be confirmed without HOA docs. Per PRODUCT.md, assessments must be known for VIABLE; gap is consistent with REJECTED given cap rate.
Taxes ESTIMATED MEDIUM at $120/yr based on Ecuador predial norms vs cadastral value. Exact Manta municipal bill unknown; even high-end of evidence range ($290) would not close the gap to 10%.
Insurance ESTIMATED MEDIUM at $300/yr for owner supplemental coastal/earthquake coverage; building structure often in alicuota. Underestimate risk is modest relative to the large cap-rate shortfall.
Rental and STR restrictions VERIFIED HIGH as Airbnb-friendly per Nahla marketing and AirROI Low regulation for Manta. Confirm reglamento interno at purchase; immaterial to REJECTED outcome.
Management ESTIMATED MEDIUM at 10% of rent ($900/yr). Self-management ($0) would raise base cap to ~6.69%—still well below 10%.
